title: Gatchalian calls for tighter monitoring of pet service providers

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Sunday urged local government units and agencies concerned across the country, such as the Bureau of Animal Industry, to inspect and audit all operating pet service providers, including crematoriums. He said LGUs and concerned agencies must ensure that such businesses are licensed, environmentally compliant, and observe clear standards of integrity. Gatchalian made the call following the discovery of 29 dead dogs and cats abandoned in sacks in San Jose del Monte, Bulacan. “[It] is a blatant violation of environmental and sanitation laws.
